game.title: The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword
game.notes: Genesis Mode. Neither the original Wii release (2011) nor the Switch HD remaster (Skyward Sword HD, 2021) has ever had a native achievement/trophy system, and no other platform release exists. Base list represents the original Wii-era content; per explicit user decision at the research checkpoint, Switch-exclusive material (button controls, free camera, item wheel, faster loading, skippable cutscenes, and the amiibo-gated Zelda & Loftwing fast-travel feature) is entirely QoL/convenience with no new areas, items, quests, or bosses, and was deliberately dropped rather than built into a bonus/DLC section — there is no `dlc` block. Hero Mode (the game's New Game+) is not required for the Platinum: it is a full second playthrough of the entire campaign under harder rules, and requiring it would mean beating the whole game twice for one trophy, which Rule 20 (Relevant Completion) counsels against — a player who has earned every other trophy has already lived everything the base campaign has to offer. A full 'collect all 27 Goddess Cubes' trophy was deliberately excluded: research found no in-game tracker (numeric or otherwise) for cube/chest completion, only the first-cube moment is verifiable as a discrete event, so only that is represented (Rule 2). Side quests are represented via two individually named, individually verifiable quests rather than a single 'complete every side quest' trophy, because Skyward Sword has no in-game quest log or Adventure Log of any kind — total side quest count is not even consistently documented across sources, let alone tracked by the game itself.

trophies.name: Wings of the Goddess
trophies.description: Descend from Skyloft to the surface for the first time.
trophies.verification: The cutscene of Link's first Loftwing dive through the clouds into Faron Woods plays.

trophies.name: The Ruby Tablet
trophies.description: Defeat Ghirahim atop the Skyview Temple.
trophies.verification: Ghirahim's defeat triggers the Skyview Temple clear cutscene and the Ruby Tablet is added to the inventory.

trophies.name: Cooled Fury
trophies.description: Defeat Scaldera, the boss of the Earth Temple.
trophies.verification: Scaldera's defeat triggers the Earth Temple clear cutscene.

trophies.name: Sealed Away
trophies.description: Drive back The Imprisoned at the Sealed Grounds for the first time.
trophies.verification: The Imprisoned is knocked back into its pit and the encounter's cutscene plays.

trophies.name: Unseen, Unheard
trophies.description: Complete a Silent Realm trial by collecting all 15 Sacred Tears without being caught.
trophies.verification: The on-screen Spirit Vessel tear counter reaches 15/15 and the trial-clear cutscene grants the trial's reward item.

trophies.name: A Little Stronger
trophies.description: Find your first Piece of Heart.
trophies.verification: The Life Gauge on the HUD grows by one quarter-heart segment and the pickup is announced.

trophies.name: Voice From the Sky
trophies.description: Strike a Goddess Cube with a Skyward Strike and open its Goddess Chest.
trophies.verification: The struck cube sinks into the ground and the corresponding chest becomes visible and lootable in the sky.

trophies.name: Bug Collector
trophies.description: Catch your first bug with the Bug Net.
trophies.verification: The bug is added to the Collection Screen.

trophies.name: A Small Kindness
trophies.description: Give Batreaux enough Gratitude Crystals to earn his first reward.
trophies.verification: Batreaux grants his 5-crystal reward and acknowledges the tally in dialogue.

trophies.name: Reinforced
trophies.description: Upgrade a shield at the Scrap Shop for the first time.
trophies.verification: The upgraded shield's new name and appearance are reflected on the Gear screen.

trophies.name: A Bug in the Brew
trophies.description: Have Bertie infuse a potion with a bug to brew its upgraded version for the first time.
trophies.verification: The '+' potion appears in the item inventory in place of the base potion.

trophies.name: Steady Hands
trophies.description: Clear a Thrill Digger board without digging up a bomb.
trophies.verification: Mr. Tubert pays out the board's reward without the game-over bomb animation having triggered.

trophies.name: The Thousand-Year Arachnid
trophies.description: Defeat Moldarach in the Lanayru Mining Facility.
trophies.verification: Moldarach's defeat triggers the Lanayru Mining Facility clear cutscene.

trophies.name: Farore's Flame
trophies.description: Defeat Koloktos in the Ancient Cistern and upgrade the Goddess Sword into the Goddess Longsword.
trophies.verification: The equipped sword's name and appearance change to Goddess Longsword on the Gear screen.

trophies.name: Room to Carry
trophies.description: Expand the Adventure Pouch for the first time.
trophies.verification: The Adventure Pouch gains an additional slot, visible on the pouch/Gear screen.

trophies.name: Nayru's Flame
trophies.description: Defeat Tentalus aboard the Sandship and upgrade the Goddess Longsword into the Goddess White Sword.
trophies.verification: The equipped sword's name and appearance change to Goddess White Sword on the Gear screen.

trophies.name: Spirit of the Sky
trophies.description: Free Levias from the Bilocyte parasite.
trophies.verification: Bilocyte's defeat triggers the cutscene of Levias being freed and granting his portion of the Song of the Hero.

trophies.name: Din's Flame
trophies.description: Defeat Ghirahim a second time in the Fire Sanctuary and forge the Master Sword.
trophies.verification: The equipped sword's name and appearance change to Master Sword on the Gear screen.

trophies.name: Where Silence Reigns
trophies.description: Complete all four Silent Realm trials: Farore's, Nayru's, Din's, and the Goddess's.
trophies.verification: Each trial's unique reward item (Water Dragon's Scale, Clawshots, Fireshield Earrings, Stone of Trials) is present in the inventory.

trophies.name: The Song of the Hero
trophies.description: Learn all four parts of the Song of the Hero from the three Dragons and Levias.
trophies.verification: The Goddess's Harp plays the complete Song of the Hero at the Statue of the Goddess, opening the way to the Goddess's Silent Realm.

trophies.name: Piece by Piece
trophies.description: Solve Sky Keep and claim the Triforce.
trophies.verification: The cutscene of the three Triforce pieces uniting plays as Link exits Sky Keep.

trophies.name: Growing Trust
trophies.description: Give Batreaux 50 Gratitude Crystals.
trophies.verification: Batreaux grants his 50-crystal reward and states the new tally in dialogue.

trophies.name: The Missing Girl
trophies.description: Complete the "Finding Kukiel" quest and discover Batreaux's hideout beneath Skyloft.
trophies.verification: Kukiel is returned safely and the entrance to Batreaux's chamber opens.

trophies.name: Four in a Row
trophies.description: Win four consecutive battles in the Thunder Dragon's Lightning Round.
trophies.verification: Stopping after the 4th consecutive win awards a Piece of Heart.

trophies.name: Perfect Landing
trophies.description: Dive through every Fortune Ring to reach maximum multiplier and land on the 50-Rupee space in Dodoh's High Dive.
trophies.verification: The multiplier shown on screen reaches its maximum as Link lands on the 50-Rupee space, and the results screen awards a Piece of Heart.

trophies.name: Full of Life
trophies.description: Collect every Piece of Heart in the game.
trophies.verification: The Life Gauge reaches its maximum length without the aid of the Life Medals.

trophies.name: A Debt Repaid
trophies.description: Give Batreaux all 80 Gratitude Crystals and witness his transformation.
trophies.verification: Batreaux's dialogue confirms the crystal tally has reached its final threshold, and the cutscene of his transformation from a cursed monster into a human plays.

trophies.name: The Collector
trophies.description: Catch at least one of every kind of bug.
trophies.verification: All twelve bug species are shown filled on the Collection Screen.

trophies.name: Unbreakable
trophies.description: Win eight consecutive battles in the Thunder Dragon's Lightning Round.
trophies.verification: Stopping after the 8th consecutive win awards the indestructible Hylian Shield.

trophies.name: The Bonds That Tie
trophies.description: Defeat Demise and bring the game to its end.
trophies.verification: Demise's defeat triggers the game's ending sequence and credits.

trophies.name: Hero of the Sky
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.
trophies.verification: All other trophies earned.
